title: Long-Span Question-Answering: Automatic Question Generation and QA-System Ranking via Side-by-Side Evaluation
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the reasoning capabilities of LLMs using classic literature that frequently explores moral and religious themes. The benchmark includes specific questions evaluating concepts such as 'personal redemption', 'divine right', 'morality and judgement', 'good vs evil', and 'sacrifice', specifically looking at the roles of religious figures like 'man of God' Bishop Myriel in Les Misérables.
